sentence: This project develops a way to verify a remote quantum computer by using error correction outputs as a fingerprint of the hardware.
This project builds a system that finds objects, estimates depth and reconstructs 3D shapes and layouts from a single image of a natural scene.
This project designs a mobile architecture that runs deep-learning models on mobile devices while keeping accuracy high and processing time short.
This project studies how quantum entanglement changes the way spin-transfer torque and spin pumping work in quantum magnetic materials.
This project tries to find out whether an alternative grading structure in biology courses changes goals, motivation and content learning.
This project uses deep learning to study how a large atmospheric pattern affects when and where tropical cyclones form.
This project studies how bacteria make and move sphingolipids and how these lipids affect the outer membrane.
This project builds a platform that recreates solid tumor tissue outside the body to test how tumors respond to drugs.
This project builds a computer model of the leg that links nerves, muscles, bones, joints and pain to predict how injury and aging change walking.
This project studies how electrons interact in atomically thin materials by using scanning probes that change the local environment.
This project studies how a protein that binds DNA helps some stem cells in male fruit flies pass on their genes more often than others.
This project tries to store data and do computing with DNA origami shapes placed on silicon surfaces and read out with light.
This project develops ways to boost the signal in nuclear magnetic resonance so that small amounts of a sample can be detected.
This project studies how light, temperature and genetics together shape how arctic plants time their growth as the growing season changes.
This project studies how artificial intelligence is treated in summer professional development programs for teachers and how it relates to computer science education.
This project develops concrete mixtures that cause less global warming and last longer.
This project develops ways to measure the genes that break down pollutants in groundwater and sediment, using freely available DNA sequencing data.
This project studies the cascading effects of hazards such as floods, droughts and wildfires on communities and looks for ways to build resilience.
